description: Ongoing improvements to the screencapture platform including bug fixes, feature enhancements, and code quality improvements

userStories.title: Add TypeScript declaration file for window.api
userStories.description: Create a global type declaration file that properly types window.api so components get full IntelliSense support
acceptanceCriteria: Create src/renderer/src/types/api.d.ts with window.api types
Export Api type from preload and use it in declaration
All components should have proper type checking for window.api calls

userStories.title: Add error boundaries to React components
userStories.description: Wrap major UI sections in error boundaries to prevent crashes from propagating
acceptanceCriteria: Create ErrorBoundary component with fallback UI
Wrap Dashboard, SessionList, and PlayerModal in error boundaries
Display user-friendly error message with retry option

userStories.title: Add loading states to async operations
userStories.description: Show loading indicators when fetching sessions, initializing OCR, or processing tasks
acceptanceCriteria: Add loading spinner component
Show loading state in SessionList while fetching
Show loading state during OCR initialization
Disable buttons during async operations

userStories.title: Add notification system for user feedback
userStories.description: Implement toast notifications for success/error messages
acceptanceCriteria: Create Toast/Notification component
Show success toast when recording saves
Show error toast when operations fail
Auto-dismiss after configurable timeout

userStories.title: Add session search and filtering
userStories.description: Allow users to search sessions by name and filter by date range
acceptanceCriteria: Add search input to SessionList
Filter sessions by name as user types
Add date range filter dropdown
Persist filter state in component

userStories.title: Add recording duration display during capture
userStories.description: Show elapsed time while recording is active
acceptanceCriteria: Display recording duration in RecordingControls
Update duration every second
Format as MM:SS or HH:MM:SS for long recordings
Reset when recording stops

userStories.title: Add confirmation dialog for destructive actions
userStories.description: Prompt user before deleting sessions or clearing data
acceptanceCriteria: Create ConfirmDialog component
Show confirmation before session deletion
Show confirmation before clearing all sessions
Include cancel and confirm buttons

userStories.title: Add keyboard navigation to session list
userStories.description: Allow arrow key navigation and Enter to select sessions
acceptanceCriteria: Up/Down arrows navigate between sessions
Enter key opens selected session
Delete key prompts to delete selected session
Escape key clears selection

userStories.title: Add auto-save recovery for interrupted recordings
userStories.description: Periodically save recording state so interrupted recordings can be recovered
acceptanceCriteria: Save recording state every 30 seconds to temp storage
On app start, check for recovery data
Prompt user to recover interrupted recording
Clean up temp data after successful save

userStories.title: Add export format options
userStories.description: Allow exporting sessions in multiple formats (JSON, CSV metadata, video)
acceptanceCriteria: Add format dropdown to export dialog
Support JSON export (existing)
Support CSV export of session metadata
Show format-specific options
